display_name: 动态频域逆变换与时域残差独立恢复网络
description: 从零训练条件化复数频域和共轭镜像校正，加条件化时域残差；只用L_s/U_s配对源信号，固定30轮。

data.representation: Original R07 source clean and received epochs01..20, source V1800x7, fixed formal168000x7
data.actual_training_labels: Paired source L_s/U_s clean and received IQ only; no TX/OE/V/F/target inputs to training
data.augmentation: Existing R07 source views 01..20 then 01..10; no newly generated training observations

permissions.claim_scope: Historical F50 same-row Phase1 regression only; Phase3 Tri-SIG-TIME F0, open-world and future registration remain separate uncompleted requirements.

checkpoint.initialization: Random scratch, context spectral and time output zero, no learned ancestor
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final E30/7410; no source ranking, early stopping or target feedback

rows.method: Input-conditioned widely-linear complex FFT correction plus conditional full-rate TCN residual
rows.seed_notes: model2026092701; original split392005; source shuffle2026103004; source corruption2026101912; receiver2026101911; evaluation2027; support not applicable

notes: Original fixed data and source corruption cache reused; no source labels, target queries, source OE, V or F in restoration training.

Global per-window context generates direct and conjugate-complex frequency corrections bounded componentwise; six context-modulated full-rate temporal blocks add a separate residual. Both outputs zero-initialized. Output is one IQ window; no runtime clean, channel truth, TX/RX or other-query input.

This is a research hypothesis. Dynamic complex per-bin gains may erase identity, overfit source signal statistics or fail due to phase ambiguity. They are not oracle channels or a guarantee of exact recovery. Old rotated-source performance was poor.

First real two-source-L_s checkpoint and frozen historical F50 no-query smoke must pass before GPU training. Candidate receives source IQ plus 0.05 spectral loss, not source simulator truth or F guidance.

Each frozen version must complete source1800x7 and exposed formal168000x7 predictions before independent CPU scoring. Six individual gaps <=3pp and clean damage <=1pp are required; target results must not change training or select candidates.
This run measures historical F50 only. Phase3 Tri-SIG-TIME F0, known/unknown open-set and registration-related evaluation are required separately and remain incomplete.
[计算环境] output roots and immutable release must be absent before launch. Other users and processes are preserved. Low performance alone does not stop the fixed schedule.
